lines.en: kings, grandees, and village headmen will be good, and the year will pass auspiciously and blessedly for them, and grain

summary.headline: Saturn’s Combustion in Libra and Scorpio
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Saturn’s combustion, first with lunar aspects and fourth-house effects, then in Libra and Scorpio. The omens cover wars, disease, famine, rain, earthquakes, trade, social disorder, and conditions in western regions, Transoxiana, Ghor, and Hejaz.
